core_idea: Lobotomy E.G.O::Sunshower Heathcliff is a Damage Dealer — **Sinking** clash-support.
playstyle_guide:
- Land Paralyze immediately before the enemy's high-value skill or your moment of weakness.
- Apply Fragile or typed Fragility on the setup turn; coordinate team burst on the next turn.
- The kit transitions to 1 Blunt DMG Up next turn. once (passive condition). Before the transition, play normally; after, you gain access to a stronger skill set.

**S1 — Umbrella Thwack** (BP 6, CP -2, 3 coins): rolls — low 6, high 12 (High).
- Gain +1 Sinking Count; [Clash Lose] Gain 3 Sinking
- Inflict 2 Sinking; [Tails Hit] Inflict +2 Sinking Count

**S2 — Puddle Stomp** (BP 10, CP -3, 4 coins): rolls — low 10, high 22 (Extremely High).
- When below -15 SP, Final Power +3; [On Use] When below -25 SP, Final Power +2
- Spend 5 Sinking to deal +20% damage; [Tails Hit] Trigger Tremor Burst

**S3 — Spread Out!** (BP 18, CP -7, 3 coins): rolls — low 18, high 39 (Extremely High).
- Gain 6 Sinking and +3 Sinking Count

Combat passive — **Rain of Tears**: At the start of the combat phase, spend 1 Sinking Count and lose SP by the current amount of Sinking.
  - Before being hit by an attack, gain Protection equal to this unit's Sinking. (Up to 5 Protection can be gained per turn).
  - When hit, gain 1 Blunt DMG Up next turn. (3 per turn).

Combat passive — **Ragged Umbrella**: 1 ally with the least SP loses 10 SP when hit by an attack and gains 1 Blunt DMG Up next turn. (Once per turn).

The transition to 1 Blunt DMG Up next turn. triggers automatically (passive condition, once per Encounter).
